reviewed_scope: All 3,118 current catalogue text keys have French draft values; 10 new welcome and release-note strings were translated in this catalogue reconciliation.
Eight current plural keys have French one/other forms, with one %ld token in each category.
The French captions.tsv terminology was consulted for skill and gameplay vocabulary, with informal player-facing phrasing and tutoiement.
Eight keys newly obsolete in the current catalogue were removed; no unknown keys remain.
The 2.0.5 release-welcome page has 11 AI-drafted additions, restored from earlier 2.0 drafts where available. One obsolete entry was removed.
review_notes: This is an AI draft. The earlier 458-entry French draft was retained and included in the completed catalogue, but it did not receive separate human linguistic approval.
157 English-identical candidates remain documented individually. The current shared unchanged.json contains all 157; that shared file was not edited in this reconciliation.
No human language approval, runtime enablement, rendered layout, bitmap glyph, accessibility, input-target, gameplay-flow or device acceptance is claimed. Keep the locale disabled.
Original Lemmings 2 text embedded in artwork or outside this interface catalogue remains separate localisation work.

candidate.note: The ignored machine-generated candidate was not merged; translations were drafted from the current English catalogue.
